project_type: FinalSay: cross-institution notice verification platform. Synchronous FastAPI backend (Python package `finalsay`) + React+Vite installable PWA frontend. Existing prototype, reconciled against an authoritative scope note. This is a focused improvement pass (P1..P6).
build_system: Makefile at repo root. Backend uses backend/.venv (Python 3.11.15 via pyenv). Frontend uses npm (Node v22) at apps/web.
test_framework: pytest with in-process FastAPI TestClient fixtures in backend/finalsay/tests/conftest.py (temp SQLite DB kept under backend tree, NOT /tmp). Current baseline: 57 tests pass.
build_command: cd apps/web && npm run build  (frontend durable check; emits dist/manifest.webmanifest + dist/sw.js). Backend has no compile step.
test_command: cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest finalsay/tests -q  (or `make test`). Eval: `make eval` runs both splits. Seed: `make seed`.
verification_instructions: 1) `cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest finalsay/tests -q` -> all pass (baseline 57). 2) `.venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal` and `--split institution` -> both exit 0. 3) Seed idempotent: `.venv/bin/python -m finalsay.seed.seed` twice -> identical counts (institutions 3, users 4, official_notices 120, submissions 65, benchmark_pairs>=300, benchmark_annotations 2x pairs, merkle_roots 1, merkle_proofs 185, anchor_blocks 1). 4) `cd apps/web && npm run build` -> green.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/eval-results.md is a NEW committed artifact the harness must emit (P3), regenerated after P1+P2. Seed writes seed/fixtures/*_official.json + gold_submissions.json (already committed; held-out temporal_bucket==1 naturalistic phrasings MUST NOT be re-engineered around mock cues). Frontend dist/ is gitignored.
setup_instructions: Backend venv already exists at backend/.venv with requirements installed (bcrypt<4.1 + email-validator pins are load-bearing; do NOT upgrade bcrypt). transformers/torch are NOT installed; P2 requires installing the HF stack into the venv (OPEN_INTERNET available) but MUST keep MOCK the default and must NOT add heavy deps to the default demo install path (requirements.txt). apps/web node_modules present.
environment_constraints: Network: OPEN_INTERNET (pip/npm/model-download/image-pull all work). /tmp is tmpfs wiped between separate tool calls; keep all artifacts under /projects/sandbox. Background daemons are REAPED across separate tool calls (--die-with-parent): a server/DB started with & in one command is gone by the next. Prefer in-process TestClient for the smoke test (P4). Docker is Podman 5.2.3 and CAN run containers (`docker run --rm hello-world` succeeded this session) but there is NO docker-compose / podman-compose binary installed. PostgreSQL 15 client+server binaries are installed on the host (pg_ctl, psql). For P5: try `docker compose` (compose v2 plugin) or a direct `docker run postgres:16` container; if compose is unavailable fall back to a direct container or host pg_ctl, and RECORD honestly what actually ran vs. what could not. Tesseract OCR engine unavailable (image OCR degrades to HTTP 422; PDF/paste work).
contribution_requirements: HARD INTEGRITY CONSTRAINT (non-negotiable): do NOT inflate, tune, or cherry-pick any metric. If a number gets worse after honest measurement, report it as-is. Do NOT push and do NOT create a PR. Keep the zero-setup MOCK + LOCAL anchor + SQLite demo working with no paid keys. Keep make test + both eval splits + npm run build green. Update HANDOFF.md with everything changed, every decision, and a clear done/skipped list for P1..P6. BUDGET-STOP RULE: work P1..P6 strictly in order; before each item confirm enough budget to finish it cleanly, else STOP with a working committable tree and log skipped items in HANDOFF.md. A half-finished P1 is worse than a clean stop.
key_patterns: Harness (backend/finalsay/eval/harness.py) is DB-free: loads officials from seed/fixtures via _officials_by_ext() and gold submissions via load_gold_submissions(). Each gold pair carries official_external_id (the correct official). Retrieval to measure against is services/comparison.py:retrieve_candidates(): filters officials by same institution, ranks by Jaccard token overlap of _submission_text (issuer+action+redacted_text), +0.1 boost when audience tokens intersect, sorts desc, takes top_k=5. For P1, mirror this scoring against the fixture officials (institution derived from external_id prefix) to compute the correct official's actual 1-based rank; misses (not in top-K) count honestly as misses; report recall@k. MockComparisonModel is the default (rule-based); HFComparisonModel (facebook/bart-large-mnli, opt-in via FINALSAY_COMPARISON_MODEL=hf) lazy-imports transformers and has NEVER been executed. Benchmark triples generated deterministically by dataset.generate_benchmark_triples() (BENCHMARK_TARGET=308); kappa currently 0.625.
